items.quote: Wir fordern Sie auf, den offenen Betrag bis spätestens 10.12.2026 zu zahlen.
items.computation: The letter states an explicit calendar due date of 10.12.2026 for the outstanding amount of EUR 226.00 (Abschlag Oktober 112,00 + Abschlag November 112,00 + Mahnkosten 2,00). This is a private-law payment deadline stated as a fixed calendar date, so it is used as written (no §187/188 BGB counting needed). 10.12.2026 falls on a Thursday, a regular working day, so no weekend/holiday adjustment under §193 BGB is required.

warnings: The letter warns it may interrupt supply if payment is not received, which is a standard but firm pressure tactic from a utility dunning letter; verify the amounts and IBAN against your own records and prior bills before paying, as the IBAN domestic (DE) and company details appear consistent with a genuine German Stadtwerke, but always double-check payee details independently rather than trusting the letter alone.
